name: Viscous Ventures
author: Addicting Games
description: Viscous Ventures is a free platform game. Brace yourself, gamer friend,  because "Viscous Venters" is a fluid and dynamic platformer here to redefine the genre and elevate your online gaming experience to squishy new heights. Get ready to dive into a world where fun knows no bounds and where your gaming skills are truly put to the test. Your journey in "Viscous Ventures" revolves around mastering the art of growing and shrinking. Need to squeeze through a tiny gap? Shrink down! Facing a colossal obstacle? Grow into a formidable rectangle! Adapt and conquer as you navigate a 2D maze of intricate challenges to test your creativity, agility, and strategy. Throughout your journey, you'll encounter a cast of quirky and formidable foes who will stop at nothing to impede your progress. With simple but challenging AI and increasingly complicated levels, you'll need all your wit and skills to emerge victorious. So, let's get wet as you embark on a gaming adventure that will challenge your mind, dazzle your senses, and provide endless hours of entertainment. Are you ready to shape your destiny? The world of "Viscous Ventures" awaits!
